verdict.rationale: Helicone's webhooks feature explicitly mentions 'Real-time evaluation: Automatically score and evaluate LLM responses for quality, safety, and relevance' triggered on live request completion, and Alerts monitor error rates/costs on live traffic, showing some continuous-evaluation capability on production data rather than only offline datasets. However, this is only a brief one-line mention with no detail on built-in evaluator types, LLM-as-judge scoring, or how this compares/integrates with offline dataset evals. Missing for 10: dedicated evaluator/scoring framework docs, examples of continuous evaluator runs on live traffic, and independent corroboration of this specific capability.
